sources.name: PSNProfiles / Exophase — official trophy list (cross-checked at PlanetGTA6)

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no online or DLC requirement, and no difficulty setting to worry about — one playthrough is enough. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours, most of it the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first story mission of the game and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to the end. It unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, begins.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to the end. It unlocks when the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to the end. It unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 4 to the end. It unlocks after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It pops with the credits and cannot be missed — keep a manual save from just before it, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story mission The Cartel Heist. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 story mission Operation Savage Glory. Story trophies unlock automatically as you play.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set. After the story, the 100% checklist opens under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. It is lenient — closer to 60% of true completion: 100 optional missions, scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all robberies, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and all 15 target decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be done in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them however you like, and the under-the-bridge ones are the quickest. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most come naturally from the story and the other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 range locations. The gold medals are not especially hard, and they also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. PowerPyx has a guide to all 12 locations.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 drone race locations — 42 races in total. Any win at a location counts for that location, so you do not need to win every single race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations around Leonida, so pick the easiest ones and do not repeat the same race — only distinct wins count.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the four arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet for a while in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing is missable.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Only certain strangers count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (deliveries) are confirmed, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. All of them can still be found after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the Zorrusso is already done, so 15 more. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on his list, then drive it to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering them in good condition pays more. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers show the Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy enough of them in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest, then Tyrone gives you Spin On This, which unlocks the trophy when you shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2, and you can track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks out to the balcony at Jason's house — follow her, choose Accept, and do the meditation. It is not marked as a normal spot and it is still unclear whether it is required, but PowerPyx did it and recommends doing it. The last spots need both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him. He gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 on the first quest. There are 15 Target Decks to clear in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found all over Leonida — PowerPyx lists 18 card set locations. You do not need every card in the game, just three finished sets.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) to scan 100 locations. There are more than 100 to choose from: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Any 100 count, so scan whatever you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. There are 8 categories with 10 challenges each, and you only need 50 — pick the easiest. Track them under Progress > Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right + Triangle). Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break away in a fast sports bike — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County works well because cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City are a good spot, once they open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Rob a couple of items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan). Just stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down 5 enemies before it runs out. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, and wear body armor so you can step out of cover. Use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — it is more accurate and full-auto. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use criminals at gang operations. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — the one at terminals E3/E4 is easiest. Go upstairs, enter the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off. You must fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it pops. Planes parked out on the airfield do not count; it has to be one connected to a boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — they stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb into a tank and fire at some enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter a store through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick the door, that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first try.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces bank vault robberies — you tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it, handing a bag to your partner (hold Right). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark more security vans. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to go unrecognised. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way; each vault pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing a bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier, you can also block a truck driving near a bank, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Escape the heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) to finish it.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every blacked-out area until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx has a guide to the best plane for unfogging the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and the 100% checklist wants all 39 — so this pops on the way. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026). The description points at a drink with a view on Ocean Beach, so the best lead is to order a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and watch for the pop. Check back here once players confirm it.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only take it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS — hack into the car, drive forward through the glass, and keep driving a little further down the street; the pop is slightly delayed. Only this blue Banshee counts. It is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs, bought at Ammu-Nation). You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and it is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for it.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always work out together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and while one character trains, the other finishes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Fitness clubs are filterable on the map under Activities.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you see the demon-face icon whenever an action counts. The profiles run Professional (stealthy robberies, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (large numbers of cops and civilians) and Irredeemable (permanent — avoid it, cops shoot on sight). It builds up passively while you do every other trophy; if it is the last one left, running over civilians and cops in a car farms it fast.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026), believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Try returning to a Payday Loans store a second time. Check back here once players confirm it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). It drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and walk her back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026), believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. Try melee attacks from a moving bike against enemies on foot. Check back here once players confirm it.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money, since they are the most expensive. It adds up naturally while you buy gear for the other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total (the 4 story garages do not count). They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3-4 are the quickest way to earn the money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Each garage adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
